resources.string: Translate the text and speech on your screen without leaving the app you are in.
In any app, tap the bubble at the edge of the screen to translate it. Hold the bubble for the menu.
When you start, a small bubble appears at the edge of your screen, over every app.
Android is asking to share your screen. Allow it, sharing the entire screen.
Without screen sharing Hammurabi cannot see what to translate.
Tap Start and allow what Android asks for. Choose to share the entire screen.
Open Instagram, Facebook, a game or any app. Tap the bubble: the text on the screen is translated in place.
Tap a translation to see the original and copy it. Tap anywhere else to close.
Hold the bubble for the menu: live translation, subtitles, language, closing. Drag it to move it.
For videos and games, turn on Live translation: subtitles and dialogue are translated as they change, just above them.
The %s translation model is on your phone. Translation works offline.
The %s translation model downloads the first time you translate (about 30 MB).
The %s translation model could not be downloaded. Check your internet connection.
Alphabet of the text on screen
Cyrillic (Russian) and Arabic letters cannot be read yet.
Speech in videos and games, translated at the bottom of the screen as subtitles.
Some apps do not let their sound be recorded; their speech cannot be subtitled.
Tiny keeps up on most phones. Base hears better but needs a fast phone. The model downloads once.
Show what was said under the translation
Subtitles cannot run on this phone: %s
Add a shortcut to Quick Settings
Hammurabi is in Quick Settings: swipe down from the top of the screen in any app and tap it.
Add it yourself: open Quick Settings, tap the pencil and drag Hammurabi in.
Keep Hammurabi out of battery saving
Some phones (Xiaomi, Huawei, Oppo, Samsung) close apps working in the background to save battery; this keeps the bubble and live translation going.
On Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO phones: in Hammurabi\'s settings → Other permissions, allow \"Display pop-up windows while running in the background\" and \"Display pop-up window\".
On Huawei and Honor phones: in Hammurabi\'s settings → Battery → App launch, let Hammurabi run in the background.
On Oppo, Realme and OnePlus phones: in Hammurabi\'s settings, allow \"Display over other apps\" and background activity.
If something goes wrong, copy the log and send it to the developer.
Text and speech are read and translated on this phone. No screenshot or sound leaves it. The models download once, the first time they are needed.
Translations are powered by Google Translate (ML Kit).

Keeps watching subtitles in videos and dialogue in games, and shows each translation just above the text. Also turned on and off from the bubble\'s menu.
To draw the area: hold the bubble → Watched area → Let me draw the area. Live translation uses more battery while on.
Drag your finger over the part where subtitles or dialogue appear.
